q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Li Ming. I’m thirteen years old. I live in Hangzhou, in the east of China. I live with my parents and my grandmother. I really like my English teacher, Ms Wang, because her lessons are fun and she always helps us when we have problems. I use my mobile phone every day, mostly to chat with my friends and listen to music. I like autumn the most, because it’s not too hot and the trees look beautiful. I prefer the morning, because I feel more awake and I can study better. I like basketball and swimming – I play basketball with my classmates after school twice a week. I usually listen to pop music, but sometimes I listen to Chinese traditional music with my grandmother. In the school holidays I visit my cousins, read a lot and sometimes travel with my family. I’d like to try rock climbing, because it looks exciting and it’s good exercise.

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都能给出完整句子并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…），使用一般现在时、would like to 等结构，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see a boy in a living room. He’s lying on a big sofa and he’s watching TV. I think he’s watching a football match, because I can see the players on a green pitch. He’s holding the remote control in his hand. He’s wearing a green and white T-shirt. The TV is on the wall and under it there’s a wooden cupboard with a lamp and some other things on it. The room looks very clean and comfortable. Maybe it’s the weekend and he’s relaxing at home. I think he’s enjoying the match, and perhaps his favourite team is playing.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要涵盖人物（在做什么、穿什么）、地点和其他物品，并用 I think / maybe / perhaps 进行合理推测；不会的词可以换种说法表达，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. The map is very important, because they don’t know the way. The hat is a good idea too, because it can be cold in the mountains, even in summer. I don’t think they need the football. They’ll be tired after walking, and it’s dangerous to play football in the mountains. The camera is nice because they can take photos of the views, but it’s quite heavy. I think the umbrella isn’t very useful – it’s difficult to carry, and if it’s windy it won’t help. A raincoat is better. Yes, they should take water and chocolate, because they will be hungry and thirsty. Chocolate gives you energy. In my opinion, the water is the most useful, because you can’t walk all day without drinking. So shall we choose the water? Great, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每一个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），主动谈到其他物品，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最有用的物品。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I like walking in the countryside, because the air is fresh and it’s quiet. I walk to school most days, because it’s only ten minutes from my home, and it’s good exercise. The last time I went for a really long walk was in the summer holidays. I walked up a hill near my grandparents’ village with my dad, and it took about four hours. My favourite outdoor activity is cycling, because I can go fast and see a lot of places. I think it’s very important for young people to spend time outdoors, because we spend too much time looking at screens. Being outside is good for our health and it helps us relax.
